harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node1’s approved boot directory as a persistent, read-only TFTP root. node2 successfully retrieves boot.cfg and firmware.bin with byte-identical hashes. Uploads and paths outside the boot root are rejected. Both nodes were restarted individually and fully recovered without changing CentOS 5.11 or kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
actions_performed: Installed signed CentOS 5-compatible TFTP packages without upgrading the OS or kernel.
Configured xinetd/in.tftpd with a chrooted root at /srv/legacy2/tftp-firmware-distribution/boot and no upload option.
Persisted the UDP/69 firewall rule, SELinux labels, service startup, and node2’s legacy TFTP connection-tracking helper.
Verified successful binary transfers and matching MD5/SHA-256 hashes.
Verified rejection of new uploads, existing-file overwrites, directory traversal, and sibling-directory requests.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Publish the staged boot tree as a persistent read-only TFTP root.
evidence.summary: Shows the enabled UDP/69 listener, chrooted boot root, enforcing SELinux-compatible labels, read-only file permissions, and persistent post-restart service state.

evidence.requirement: node2 downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin with firmware bytes preserved.
evidence.summary: Original and downloaded MD5/SHA-256 hashes match exactly before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Reject uploads and requests outside the boot root.
evidence.summary: Upload attempts return rejection errors, traversal returns File not found, no probe file is created, and approved-file hashes remain unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel using legacy-compatible software.
evidence.summary: Signed native CentOS 5 packages were installed; post-restart checks remain CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence and recovery.
evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID d5a54c23…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 18e80fa2…, recovered service/data, and successful remote transfers.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node2 restart persistence and recovery.
evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID 84cc174d…, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID eccd235f…, restored firewall helper, and successful post-restart downloads.
